newsitem.title: usa: Kansas feedlot cattle market Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow on Monday, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate, demand fair.
Confirmed - 3,500 last week - none last year - 100
Wk to date -11,800 last week - 5,400 last year - 6,200
Steers - few Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 63.00.

Sales confirmed on 1,400 slaughter steers and 2,100 slaughter heifers Monday. For the week to date including late Friday and the weekend 11,800 head confirmed, including 8,300 head previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
